description: Replay your agent journal oldest→newest (CO 230-001). Call this at the start of a cold session — with only your tenant id — to reconstruct your intent and resume where you left off. On a tenant whose workflow runs journal themselves, add exclude_tags ["act-record"] to replay the reasoning without the run trail; the reply's excluded says how many entries that left out. Pairs with federation_journal_append. Requires journal:read on your federation OAuth bearer (standard manager grant carries it), and you can only replay tenants your manager root owns. Returns: The journal entries oldest→newest (up to limit). Example: call federation_journal_read with arguments {"tenant_id":"<tenant_id>"}.

exclude_tags.description: Leave out entries carrying ANY of these tags, applied before limit. ["act-record"] replays the reasoning only — the entries workflow runs write about themselves are left out, and the reply's `excluded` says how many.

tags.description: Keep only entries carrying ANY of these tags, applied before limit (e.g. ["ruling"], or ["act-record"] for the run trail alone).

tenant_id.description: Your tenant id whose journal to replay.

name: federation_journal_read
